You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

What will Marcy's annual pension be if she quits after 30 years? Marcy receives an annual pension of $50,000 after working for the same company for 40 years. Starting after 20 years of employment, Marcy becomes entitled to 5% of the pension's value per year. Marcy quits after working for the company for 30 years. Marcy has worked for the company for 30 years when she reviews her pension eligibility. Marcy's company defines one eligible year as one full year of employment. Marcy earns pension credit at a constant rate throughout each eligible year. Only employment after the twentieth year counts toward this percentage.
